description: This file defines smart pointer classes such as scoped_ptr, scoped_array, and scoped_ptr_malloc, which manage ownership and automatic deallocation of pointers in C++. It includes implementations for managing single objects, arrays, and malloc-allocated memory with customizable free functions.

classes.name: scoped_ptr
classes.description: A smart pointer that owns a single object and deletes it upon destruction.

classes.name: scoped_array
classes.description: A smart pointer that owns an array of objects and deletes it with delete[] upon destruction.

classes.name: scoped_ptr_malloc
classes.description: A smart pointer that manages malloc-allocated memory with a customizable free function.

classes.name: ScopedPtrMallocFree
classes.description: A helper class that wraps the C library free() function for use with scoped_ptr_malloc.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Replaces the managed object with a new pointer, deleting the old one.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the managed pointer, asserting it's not null.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides access to the managed object, asserting it's not null.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the managed pointers of two smart pointer objects.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the managed pointer and returns it, setting internal pointer to null.
